Definition: Bilateral intermediate-goods exports from economy i to economy j, aggregated to HS2 and measured in millions of current U.S. dollars.
Source: CEPII BACI HS2007; UNSD HS2007-BEC Rev. 4 correspondence

Definition: Indicator equal to one when at least one preferential trade agreement was in force for the bilateral pair in the preceding year.
Source: WTO RTA Database; World Bank Deep Trade Agreements Database

Definition: Number of legally enforceable policy areas in active agreements, divided by ten; overlapping agreements are combined using the provision-level maximum.
Source: World Bank Deep Trade Agreements Horizontal Content Database

Definition: Annual mean of the global Geopolitical Risk Index, standardized using the 1985-2019 historical mean and standard deviation.
Standardized annual mean of the geopolitical-threat component.
Standardized annual mean of the geopolitical-acts component.
Standardized maximum monthly global GPR observation within each year.
Source: Authors' calculation from Caldara and Iacoviello (2022)

Definition: Average of standardized exporter- and importer-specific GPR indices for each bilateral pair-year.
Source: Authors' calculation from country-specific GPR series

Definition: Maximum of standardized exporter- and importer-specific GPR indices for each bilateral pair-year.
Source: Authors' calculation from country-specific GPR series

Definition: Indicator equal to one when a pair-HS2 relationship with positive trade in t-1 remains positive in t.
Indicator equal to one when an exited trade link records positive trade again in t+1.
Indicator equal to one when an exited trade link records positive trade in t+1 or t+2.
Indicator equal to one when trade in t+1 returns to at least the pre-exit value in t-1.
Indicator equal to one when trade in t+1 or t+2 returns to at least the pre-exit value in t-1.
Natural logarithm of one plus intermediate-goods trade value in the preceding year.
